prompt: Start from the still. Nobody comes in. The screens carry on by themselves: the wall screen's charts redraw, a window slides open and closes, the call grid flickers between empty tiles. One leather chair, still turning slowly from when it was left, comes to rest. The light outside fades a little darker over the eight seconds and a few more windows light up across the city. The camera pushes slowly along the length of the table towards the far screen. Sound: the hum of the building's air handling, a faint electronic notification tone from the table screen, distant city traffic through the glass. No speech, no music. Thanks.
